name: revit-mcp-bimlynx
description: Read, create and edit elements in the Revit model you have open, through the RevitMCP add-in running inside Revit 2025, 2026 or 2027 on the same Windows machine.

revit_version.title: Revit version
revit_version.description: The Revit you run: 2025, 2026 or 2027. It picks the add-in's local port (7890, 7891 or 7892).

tool_profile.title: Tool groups
tool_profile.description: Optional. Comma-separated groups to expose: inspection, model-health, recipes, coordination, architecture, documentation, editing, view. Leave empty for all tools.
